headline: Review of 179-apartment building replacing Stop and Shop at 37 Enon Street, plus sign requests on Dodge and Essex Streets.
summary: Three businesses have requested signs: Gold Coast Pilates Therapy, The Happy Crab Play Center, and PerioNorth. Temporary signs and banners are also up for discussion.
items: Wall and window sign applications for Gold Coast Pilates Therapy at 3 Dodge Street
Window sign applications for The Happy Crab Play Center at 451 Essex Street
Freestanding sign application for PerioNorth at 56 Dodge Street
Site plan review for demolition of existing Stop and Shop and new building with 179 one and two bedroom apartments and +/- 2,600 square foot retail space at 37 Enon Street
Discussion on temporary signage and temporary banners
location: Temporary City of Beverly City Hall, First Floor – Large Conference Room, 175 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA 01915
